page_note: Page is essentially pure ecclesial-hortatory material: instructions to a disciple about proclaiming and building the church, the work and burden of the one who speaks/commands in the church, and a closing apostolic-dialogue exchange where the disciple worships the Apostle and accepts the commission. No cosmological substrate present. Heavy damage (80%) but what survives is uniformly church-institutional. Editorial fatigue score reflects shift from ecclesial-heavy first half to apostolic-dialogue-heavy second half (the closing scene with the disciple).
